logp.method_description: n-Octanol (2.0 mL) and 1.5 mL of PBS (pH 7.4, 0.01 M) were added to a 5 mL centrifuge tube. The two phases stood overnight before 0.5 mL of [99mTc]Tc-Me2P2O4 solution was added to it. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuged for 5 min (at 3000 r/min), and allowed to stand for 5 min. The organic and aqueous phases (200 µL) were pipetted (3 times in parallel for each group) into another centrifuge tube, and the radioactive counts were determined for calculating the distribution coefficient log D7.4 (D7.4 is the ratio of the radioactive counts of the n-octanol phase to that of the aqueous phase at pH 7.4). Then 1 mL of n-octanol containing [99mTc]Tc-Me2P2O4 was transferred to another centrifuge tube, and 2 mL of n-octanol and 3 mL of PBS were added to repeat the previous experimental steps, and log D7.4 was calculated until it was stable. Results were expressed as mean ± standard deviation (n = 3).
